home.ctaTitle: Let's make something for your celebration
home.ctaBody: Put together roughly what you have in mind, send it over, and we'll take it from there. It isn't an order. It is simply a much better starting point than a blank message.

process.title: Tell us about it
process.body: Send the date, roughly how many people, and any flavours or images you're drawn to. A rough idea is enough to start.

process.title: We design it together
process.body: We'll come back with a direction, a flavour pairing, and a price. Nothing is locked in until you're happy with it.

process.title: It gets baked
process.body: Everything is made fresh in the days before your event. Nothing is frozen, nothing is made in advance.

process.title: Collection or delivery
process.body: Pick it up chilled and boxed, or we'll deliver locally and set it up for you.

faq.question: How far in advance should I order?
faq.answer: Two weeks is comfortable for most cakes, and four to six weeks for weddings and larger tiered work. Shorter notice is sometimes possible. It is always worth asking.

faq.question: Can you work around allergies?
faq.answer: Often, yes. Nut free and dairy free options are usually workable with notice. This is a home kitchen that handles nuts, dairy, gluten, and eggs, so we cannot guarantee an allergen free environment.

faq.question: Do you deliver?
faq.answer: Local delivery and setup can be arranged for tiered cakes. Single tier cakes are usually collected.

faq.question: How does payment work?
faq.answer: A deposit confirms your date, with the balance due before collection. Details are agreed directly when the order is confirmed.

faq.question: Can you recreate a cake I've seen elsewhere?
faq.answer: We'll happily use a photo as a starting point, but we won't copy another baker's work outright. The result will be our interpretation of what you love about it.

aboutStory: TODO(content): the baker's story goes here. Two or three paragraphs about how the bakery started, what drew you to cake specifically, and what you care about most when you're making one.

This is the most trusted content on a home bakery site. Customers are letting a stranger cook for their celebration. A photograph of you and a story in your own voice does more than any amount of design.
The Persian influences in this work aren't decorative. Saffron, rosewater, cardamom, and pistachio are the flavours of a childhood, and the geometry comes from tilework worth looking at closely.
